_note: School campus layout — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the walkable world (PROJECT.md section 7). Minimal placeholder campus (reference screenshots): TWO buildings (a west building running north-south and a south building running east-west) forming an L around a large rectangular grass field, with a parking lot directly ABOVE (north of) the buildings. There are NO outer perimeter walls — only the two buildings are solid; everything else is walkable grass. The 2D map (Milestone 9) and classroom doors (Milestone 7) are generated from THIS file. Coordinates: x = east(+)/west(-), z = south(+)/north(-), y = up. 'walls' are the solid building blocks (center x,z + size w,d) used for BOTH rendering and collision — keep them axis-aligned. Doors line up with classrooms.json by id and sit on the field-facing wall of each room; 'axis' is the direction the door opening runs along (z = opening runs north-south on an east/west-facing wall, x = opening runs east-west on a north/south-facing wall). 'cars' are decorative parked cars (no collision, so the lot stays walkable). 'boundary' and 'gate' are METADATA ONLY (not rendered): the gate returns at Milestone 11 (arrival animation). Real room numbers/names arrive at Milestone 16.
